separation_rules: USD amounts formatted with '$' symbol and thousands commas (e.g., '$3,500')
KHR amounts formatted with 'KHR' prefix or '៛' and Khmer thousands grouping (e.g., 'KHR 2,000,000')
Dual-currency events separate sums with middle dot separator (e.g., '$3,500 · KHR 2,000,000')
Zero exchange conversion: client never guesses or applies exchange rates (e.g. 1 USD = 4000 KHR)

permission_gate.budget_view: Requires MANAGE_BUDGET permission; hidden from unauthorized viewers
permission_gate.gifts_view: Requires VIEW_EVENT and owner context; hidden from public or restricted collaborators
